We're introducing Saved Views, a new way to work faster in your projects. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort settings every time you open a project, you can now save your exact configuration and return to it with a single click. Saved Views is available today, and it's included in all paid plans at no extra cost.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering every project, filter combination, or sprint you regularly track. Whether you're monitoring overdue tasks, tracking a teammate's workload, or watching progress on a launch, your setup is always one click away.

Saved Views also make collaboration easier. Any view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered list without repeating setup steps. Share a view once, and your teammates instantly see the same tasks, sorted and filtered exactly as you intended.

We built this feature based on your feedback about repetitive setup work, and we think it will save real time across busy teams.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
